narrative.overview: A hand-painted shopfront at page scale, after dark. The wok is the only light on the street; enamel boards carry the rate list; the one thing that never changes is that the shutter is up.
keyCharacteristics: Enamel paint colours at full commitment, never tints; warm-black night walls
Light has a source: the wok's fire and the tube-light signs, nothing else glows
Painted lettering (Yatra One) over condensed board type (Teko)
Boards on chains, posters pasted over one another
Motion carries real mechanisms: a shutter lifting, a lane of boards, bills layering

rules.name: The Real Price Rule
rules.body: Prices, hours and links come from one config file. Nothing on a board is invented; an unsupplied link is hidden, not faked.

rules.name: The Enamel Rule
rules.body: Colour is a full coat on a whole region (night wall, ticker, board, slab), never a tint, and no gradients on text or plates. Gradients are allowed only as steel shading and as firelight washing a dark wall. White is milk enamel (#fbf6e8), black is soot (#1b1310).

rules.name: The Mark Rule
rules.body: Veg and non-veg are always shape plus colour plus a ribbon label; colour alone never carries the diet.

rules.name: The Fire Light Rule
rules.body: Light needs a source: the wok's fire, a tube-light sign or lettering, a rail. Enamel plates may be lit from below. No glowing buttons, cards or icons.

rules.name: The One Flicker Rule
rules.body: One thing flickers at a time: the hero name, at irregular intervals. Everything stops under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Hung Rule
rules.body: Boards and signs hang from chains and sit a little off true (±0.9deg). They sway with scroll speed; they never bounce.

dos: Do set display lettering in Yatra One at 6rem or below (the hero name is the one exception), and board lines and prices in Teko.
Do keep every interactive target at least 44px tall with a 3px focus ring in the surface's contrast colour.
Do let content be visible without JavaScript and give every animation a reduced-motion path.
Do give each section its own wall: the night kitchen, the turmeric ticker, night green for the rate list, a lit enamel facts board on night.
donts: Don't use photography stand-ins, gradient text, or hard offset shadows. Don't glow anything that is not lit.
Don't put a kicker or number above a heading.
Don't use identical cards: boards differ in width and structure, slabs differ in colour and tilt.
Don't pull the shutter down: the lift is one-way and the footer says why.
